name: token-saver
description: Run checks, compact output, locate repository content and collect read-only status.

interface.shortDescription: Run checks and compact their output with recoverable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Development plugin with an existing-check runner, captured-output compaction, precise repository lookup, batched GitHub status and a versioned result contract. Other helpers remain planned.
defaultPrompt: Run an agreed check and retain its complete output.
Compact an existing log and retain its diagnostics.
Locate files or text in an existing repository.
Collect read-only status for known GitHub PRs.
